objective: To upload Mapping per Destination rows for the ongoing calculation period into MASTER_CANDIDATE_PART_DEST.
To validate each Part No group and replace mappings only for changed parts (Proposed); on any file or row error, save no master changes (Proposed).

constraints: Only Active parts and the ongoing calculation period can be changed (BR-12 / BR-13).
Parts absent from the workbook are unchanged; each included Part No group replaces all its destinations (Proposed).
FSD mapping export is an .xls HTML table; upload workbook format, columns, sheet name and file limits are not defined and remain proposed.
MASTER_CANDIDATE_PART and MASTER_CANDIDATE_PART_DEST are named in the existing draft; upload log, temp table and destination master source are proposed or TBD.
All-or-nothing saving, result workbook, empty-destination placeholder behavior and temp-row retention require confirmation.
Changed-field history is outside this batch draft; confirm event coverage and retention with FSD OP-03.

steps.text: Retrieve UPLOAD_ID and the upload record from TB_R_CD_UPLOAD_LOG.
children: If the record or stored file is missing, log message no. 4 and stop.

steps.text: Set STATUS = 'PROCESSING' and START_DT, then check the proposed workbook format, size, row count, Upload sheet and headers (see 4.1).
children: If invalid, log message no. 5, set STATUS = REJECTED and proceed to step 6.

steps.text: Load every row into TB_T_CD_UPLOAD_MAPPING as text with UPLOAD_ID and Excel row number.
Validate all rows, collect errors and group valid rows by PART_NO (see 4.2). If any row fails, log message no. 6, set STATUS = REJECTED and do not write master data.

Compare each valid group with the current ongoing-period mapping. Skip unchanged groups (message no. 7); replace changed groups and update the parent part in one transaction. On database error, roll back, log message no. 8 and reject the upload.
Create the proposed result workbook; update status, counts, result path and END_DT in TB_R_CD_UPLOAD_LOG. Log message no. 9 if report creation fails; write batch end message no. 2 and return status.

func_desc.text: This proposed batch processes one Mapping per Destination workbook for the ongoing calculation period. The FSD defines Mapping export and screen editing, but not Mapping upload, its screen mode or template.

items: Only Active parts in the ongoing period can be changed (BR-12 / BR-13). Past periods are read-only.
Parts absent from the file are unchanged. Each included Part No group replaces all that part's destinations (Proposed).
The proposed workbook is .xlsx with an Upload sheet and four columns in Appendix. The FSD export currently uses .xls HTML, so the base-file relationship must be confirmed.
All-or-nothing saving is proposed; confirm before development.
Proposed extension is .xlsx, maximum 5 MB and maximum 5,000 data rows.
Proposed sheet name is Upload; empty-file behavior is TBD.
Four proposed template headers exist in the order shown in Appendix. Strict order and extra-column handling are TBD.

func_desc.text: Validate every row and collect all errors. Rules below align with the FSD where possible; file-template behavior is proposed.

rows: Exists in MASTER_CANDIDATE_PART for the ongoing period and PART_STATUS = Active.
Destination code exists in destination master; physical table name TBD.
A destination code appears only once per Part No group.
Mapped row requires a positive whole number. Blank destination row is only a proposed placeholder when the part has no current mapping; it cannot clear existing mappings.
Sum is not greater than Max Case/Day. A lower total is allowed.
Read-only proposed field and ignored; recalculate the limit from MASTER_CANDIDATE_PART.

items: For each changed Part No group, delete existing MASTER_CANDIDATE_PART_DEST rows for the ongoing period and insert uploaded destination rows.
Do not change parts absent from the workbook. Skip a group when its destination codes and Case/Day values are unchanged.
For a changed group, set parent SYNC_STATUS = 0, LAST_SOURCE = UPLOAD, LAST_UPLOAD_ID = UPLOAD_ID, CHANGED_BY to the login user and CHANGED_DT to server time.
Commit all changed groups together (Proposed). On database error, roll back the complete upload and reject the run.
The existing draft proposes Summary, Result, Re-upload and Changes sheets; exact columns, file path and retention need confirmation.
Confirm whether the upload uses a new .xlsx template or the current .xls HTML export, and confirm blank-row behavior for clearing mappings.
Confirm trigger, concurrent-run handling, physical table names, data types, temp-row retention and history behavior (FSD OP-03).
